description: Sentiment model comparison on the Kaggle 'Sentiment Analysis for Financial News' corpus (Malo et al. 2014). Test split: 483 held-out rows, stratified, seed 42.

fine_tuned.model: finbert-ft (FinBERT + 3 epochs on 4,363 rows, Kaggle P100)

conclusion: Base FinBERT is already well-calibrated to financial headlines (it was originally trained on this corpus), so the shipped Docker image uses base weights. The fine-tuning pipeline (src/scripts/train_sentiment.py, kaggle/ kernel) is included for reproducibility and for recalibration on new data.
note: Full-corpus fine-tuned accuracy (93.7%) is training-set-inflated and deliberately not used as a headline metric.
